and s.Y>=O.Y
and s.Y<=O.Y+P.Y
then

end
end end

F.AddToRegistry=function(aa, M, N, O)
local P=#F.Registry+1
local Q={
Instance=M,
Properties=N,
Idx=P,
}

table.insert(F.Registry,Q)
F.RegistryMap[M]=Q

if O then
table.insert(F.HudRegistry,Q)
end end


F.RemoveFromRegistry=function(aa, M)
local N=F.RegistryMap[M]

if N then
for O=#F.Registry,1,-1 do
if F.Registry[O]==N then
table.remove(F.Registry,O)
end
end

for O=#F.HudRegistry,1,-1 do
if F.HudRegistry[O]==N then
table.remove(F.HudRegistry,O)
end
end

F.RegistryMap[M]=nil
end end

aq=aq*10
end

if ar.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Right then

end

ag:SetValue(ag.Value-aq)
end

w[ae]=ag
end

return ag end

local af={}

af.new=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()

_tasks={},
},af)
end)

return af[ah]
else
return ag._tasks[ah]
end
end)




af.__newindex=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ag,ah,aj)
if af[ah]~=nil then
return warn(("'%s' is reserved"):format(tostring(ah)),2)
end

local ak=ag._tasks
local al=ak[ah]

if al==aj then
return
end

ak[ah]=aj

if al then
if typeof(al)=="thread"then
return coroutine.status(al)=="suspended"and task.cancel(al)or nil
end

if type(al)=="function"then
al()
elseif typeof(al)=="RBXScriptConnection"then
al:Disconnect()
elseif typeof(al)=="Instance"and al:IsA("Tween")then
al:Pause()
al:Cancel()
al:Destroy()
elseif al.Destroy then
al:Destroy()
elseif al.detach then
al:detach()
end
end
end)




af.mark=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ag,ah)
ag:add(ah)
return ah
end)




af.add=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ag,ah)
if not ah then
return error("task cannot be false or nil",2)
end

local aj=#ag._tasks+1
ag[aj]=ah

return aj
end)



af.removeTask=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ag,ah)
local aj=ag._tasks
aj[ah]=nil
end)


af.clean=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ag)
local ah=ag._tasks


for aj,ak in pairs(ah)do
if typeof(ak)=="RBXScriptConnection"then
ah[aj]=nil
ak:Disconnect()
end
end


local aj,ak=next(ah)

while ak~=nil do
ah[aj]=nil

if typeof(ak)=="thread"then
if coroutine.status(ak)=="suspended"then
task.cancel(ak)
end
else
if type(ak)=="function"then
ak()
elseif typeof(ak)=="RBXScriptConnection"then
ak:Disconnect()
elseif typeof(ak)=="Instance"and ak:IsA("Tween")then
ak:Pause()
ak:Cancel()
ak:Destroy()
elseif ak.Destroy then
ak:Destroy()
elseif ak.detach then
ak:detach()
end
end

aj,ak=next(ah)
end
end)


return af

end)

c("Utility/FiniteStateMachine",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)





local af={}
af.__index=af


local ag=aa("Utility/Logger")





af.new=function(ah, aj)
local ak=setmetatable({},af)
ak.states=ah
ak.current=aj
ak.initial=aj
ak.started=false


ak:get(ak.current)

return ak end





af.get=function(ah, aj)
for ak,al in next,ah.states do
if al.identifier~=aj then
continue
end

return al
end

return ag.warn(string.format("(%s) State does not exist in states table.",aj))end





af.has=function(ah, aj)
for ak,al in next,ah.states do
if al.identifier~=aj then
continue
end

return true
end

return false end



af.stop=function(ah)

if not ah.started then
return ag.warn("Finite state machine has not been started.")
end


local aj=ah:get(ah.current)
aj:detach()


ah.started=false
ah.current=ah.initial end



af.start=function(ah)

if ah.started then
return ag.warn("Finite state machine has already been started.")
end


ah.started=true
ah.current=ah.initial


local aj=ah:get(ah.current)
aj:start(ah)end




af.transition=function(ah, aj)
if not ah.started then
return ag.warn("Finite state machine has not been started.")
end


local ak=ah:get(ah.current)
ak:detach()


ah.current=aj


local al=ah:get(aj)
al:start(ah)end



return af

end)

)end







ah.new=function(aj, ak, al)

c("Features/Game/Tweening",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)

local af,


ag,


ah={active=false,queue={}},aa("Utility/Configuration"),game:GetService("Players")



af.update=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(aj)
af.active=false

local ak=af.current()
if not ak then
return
end

local al=typeof(ak.goal)=="Instance"and ak.goal or nil
if al and not al.Parent then
return af.stop(ak.identifier)
end

local am=ah.LocalPlayer
local an=am and am.Character
if not an then
return
end

local ao=an:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not ao then
return
end

af.active=true

local ap,
aq=ao.Position,typeof(ak.goal)=="Instance"and ak.goal.CFrame or ak.goal
local ar=aq.Position

local as=(ar-ap).Magnitude

if as<=0.01 then
return
end

local at,
au,

av=(ar-ap)/as,(ag.expectOptionValue("TweenStudsPerSecond")or 200)*aj,nil

if au>=as then
av=ar
else
av=ap+(at*au)
av=Vector3.new(av.X,ar.Y,av.Z)
end

local aw=(aq-aq.Position)

local ax,ay,az,aA,aB,aC,aD,aE,aF,aG,aH,aI=aw:GetComponents()

if
aA==aA
and aB==aB
and aC==aC
and aD==aD
and aE==aE
and aF==aF
and aG==aG
and aH==aH
and aI==aI
then
ao.CFrame=CFrame.new(av)*aw
else
ao.CFrame=CFrame.new(av)
end


local aJ=(ar-av).Magnitude

ak.reached=false

if aJ>=1.0 then
return
end

if ak.swc then
return af.stop(ak.identifier)
end

ak.reached=true
end)




af.get=function(aj)
for ak,al in next,af.queue do
if al.identifier~=aj then
continue
end

return ak,al
end

return nil end




af.wait=function(aj)
local ak,al=af.get(aj)
if not al then
return
end

repeat
task.wait()
until al.reached end




af.current=function()
return af.queue[#af.queue]end






af.goal=function(aj, ak, al)
local am,an=af.get(aj)

if an then
an.goal=ak
an.swc=al
an.reached=false
else
table.insert(af.queue,1,{identifier=aj,goal=ak,swc=al,reached=false})
end end




af.stop=function(aj)
local ak,al=af.get(aj)
if not ak then
return
end

table.remove(af.queue,ak)end



return af

end)

c("Utility/Deserializer",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)

local af,


ag={},aa("Utility/DeserializerStream")


local ah={
[0xc0]=nil,
[0xc2]=false,
[0xc3]=true,
[0xc4]=ag.byte,
[0xc5]=ag.short,
[0xc6]=ag.int,
[0xca]=ag.float,
[0xcb]=ag.double,
[0xcc]=ag.byte,
[0xcd]=ag.unsignedShort,
[0xce]=ag.unsignedInt,
[0xcf]=ag.unsignedLong,
[0xd0]=ag.byte,
[0xd1]=ag.short,
[0xd2]=ag.int,
[0xd3]=ag.long,
[0xd9]=ag.byte,
[0xda]=ag.unsignedShort,
[0xdb]=ag.unsignedInt,
[0xdc]=ag.unsignedShort,
[0xdd]=ag.unsignedInt,
[0xde]=ag.unsignedShort,
[0xdf]=ag.unsignedInt,
}local aj=function(





aj, ak)
local al={}

for am=1,ak do
al[am]=af.at(aj)
end

return al end local ak=function(






ak, al)
local am={}

for an=1,al do
am[af.at(ak)]=af.at(ak)
end

return am end





af.at=function(al)
local am=al:byte()
local an=ah[am]or function()
error("Unhandled byte data: "..am)
end

if am==0xde or am==0xdf then
return ak(al,an(al))
end

if am>=0x80 and am<=0x8f then
return ak(al,am-0x80)
end

if am>=0x90 and am<=0x9f then
return aj(al,am-0x90)
end

if am==0xdc or am==0xdd then
return aj(al,an(al))
end

if am==0xc4 or am==0xc5 or am==0xc6 then
return al:leReadBytes(an(al))
end

if am==0xd9 or am==0xda or am==0xdb then
return al:string(an(al))
end

if am>=0xa0 and am<=0xbf then
return al:string(am-0xa0)
end

if am==0xc0 or am==0xc1 or am==0xc2 then
return ah[am]
end

if am>=0x00 and am<=0x7f then
return am
end

if am>=0xe0 and am<=0xff then
return-32+(am-0xe0)
end

return typeof(an)=="function"and an(al)or an end





af.unmarshal_one=function(al)
return af.at(ag.new(al))end



return af

end)
c("Utility/DeserializerStream",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)



local af={}
af.__index=af




af.leReadBytes=function(ag, ah)
local aj={}

for ak=ag.index+1,ag.index+ah do
aj[#aj+1]=ag.source[ak]
end

ag.index=ag.index+ah

if ag.index>#ag.source then
return error("leReadBytes - read overflow")
end

return aj end





af.beReadBytes=function(ag, ah)
local aj={}

for ak=ag.index+ah,ag.index+1,-1 do
aj[#aj+1]=ag.source[ak]
end

ag.index=ag.index+ah

if ag.index>#ag.source then
return error("beReadBytes - read overflow")
end

return aj end





af.string=function(ag, ah)
local aj,
ak=ag.source,buffer.create(ah)

for al=ag.index+1,ag.index+ah do
buffer.writeu8(ak,al-ag.index-1,aj[al])
end

ag.index=ag.index+ah


if ag.index>#ag.source then
return error("string - read overflow")
end

return buffer.readstring(ak,0,ah)end




af.unsignedLong=function(ag)
local ah=ag:beReadBytes(8)
local aj,
ak=bit32.bor(ah[1],bit32.lshift(ah[2],8),bit32.lshift(ah[3],16),bit32.lshift(ah[4],24)),bit32.bor(ah[5],bit32.lshift(ah[6],8),bit32.lshift(ah[7],16),bit32.lshift(ah[8],24))
return bit32.bor(aj,bit32.lshift(ak,32))end




af.unsignedInt=function(ag)
local ah=ag:beReadBytes(4)
return bit32.bor(ah[1],bit32.lshift(ah[2],8),bit32.lshift(ah[3],16),bit32.lshift(ah[4],24))end




af.unsignedShort=function(ag)
local ah=ag:beReadBytes(2)
return bit32.bor(ah[1],bit32.lshift(ah[2],8))end




af.float=function(ag)
local ah=ag:beReadBytes(4)
local aj,
ak,
al,

c("Features/Combat/EntityHistory",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)

local af,


ag,


ah={},{},3.0






af.add=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(aj,al,am,an)
local ap=ag[aj]or{}

if not ag[aj]then
ag[aj]=ap
end

ap[#ap+1]={
position=al,
timestamp=an,
velocity=am,
}

while true do
local aq=ap[1]
if not aq then
break
end

if tick()-aq.timestamp<=ah then
break
end

table.remove(ap,1)
end
end)





af.vall=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(aj,al)
local am=ag[aj]
if not am then
return nil
end

local an={}

for ap,aq in next,am do
if tick()-aq.timestamp>al then
continue
end

an[#an+1]=aq.velocity
end

return an
end)




af.yrate=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(aj)
local al=ag[aj]
if not al or#al<2 then
return nil
end

local am,
an=al[#al],al[#al-1]
local ap=am.timestamp-an.timestamp
if ap<=1e-4 then
return nil
end

local aq,
ar=Vector3.new(an.position.LookVector.X,0,an.position.LookVector.Z).Unit,Vector3.new(am.position.LookVector.X,0,am.position.LookVector.Z).Unit
local as,
at=aq:Dot(ar),aq:Cross(ar).Y
local au=math.atan2(at,as)
return au/ap
end)






af.pstepped=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(aj,al,am)
local an=ag[aj]
if not an or#an==0 then
return nil
end

if not al or al<=0 then
return nil
end

local ap,
aq={},an[#an].timestamp

for ar,as in next,an do
if aq-as.timestamp>am then
continue
end

ap[#ap+1]=as.position
end

if#ap==0 then
return{}
end

local ar=math.min(al,#ap)
local as=table.create(ar)

for at=1,ar do
as[at]=ap[math.max(math.floor((at*#ap)/ar),1)]
end

return as
end)





af.pclosest=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(aj,al)
if not ag[aj]then
return nil
end

local am,
an=nil,nil

for ap,aq in next,ag[aj]do
local ar=math.abs(al-aq.timestamp)

if am and ar>=am then
continue
end

an=aq.position
am=ar
end

return an
end)


return af

end)

at:mark(aM:connect("StateListener_EffectRemoved",aG))
at:mark(aI:connect("StateListener_DescendantAdded",aC))

aF(aO)
end

aC(aO)
end

al.warn("StateListener initialized.")end

c("Game/QueuedBlocking",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)

local af,





ag,


ah,


aj,


al,


am,


an={BLOCK_TYPE_DEFLECT=1,BLOCK_TYPE_NORMAL=2,},aa("Game/InputClient"),aa("Game/KeyHandling"),aa("Utility/Logger"),aa("Utility/Signal"),aa("Utility/Maid"),aa("Features/Combat/StateListener")


local ap,


aq,


ar,
as=am.new(),{},game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),game:GetService("RunService")local at=function()



local at=ar:FindFirstChild("EffectReplicator")
if not at then
return
end

local au=aa(at)
if not au then
return
end

local av=ah.getRemote("Block")
if not av then
return
end

local aw=ah.getRemote("Unblock")
if not aw then
return
end

local az=ag.getInputData()
if not az then
return
end

if an.hblock()then
return af.empty()
end


local aA=au:HasEffect("Blocking")


az["f"]=true


for aB,aC in next,aq do
local aD,
aF=aC.dt and os.clock()-aC.start>=aC.dt,aC.type==af.BLOCK_TYPE_DEFLECT and aA

if not aF and not aD then
continue
end

af.stop(aB)
end


local aB=0

for aC,aD in next,aq do
aB=aB+1
end


az["f"]=aB>0


local aD=Instance.new("RemoteEvent").FireServer

if aA then
return aB<=0 and aD(aw)
end

if not au:FindEffect("Action")and not au:FindEffect("Knocked")then
return aB>0 and aD(av)
end end






af.invoke=function(au, av, aw)
local az=ar:FindFirstChild("EffectReplicator")
if not az then
return
end

local aA=aa(az)
if not aA then
return
end

local aB=ah.getRemote("Block")
if not aB then
return aj.warn("QueuedBlocking.invoke(...) - Missing block remote.")
end

local aD,
aF=ag.sprintFunctionCache,ag.getInputData()

if not aD or not aF then
return aj.warn(
"QueuedBlocking.invoke(...) - (%s, %s) - Missing important data.",
tostring(aD),
tostring(aF)
)
end

local aG=aA:FindEffect("M1Buffering")

if aG then
aG:Remove()
end

if aA:HasEffect("CastingSpell")then
return
end

aB:FireServer()

aF["f"]=true

aD(false)

aj.warn(
"QueuedBlocking.invoke(...) - (at %.2f) Invoking block action '%s' of type %d with dead time (%s) to queue.",
os.clock(),
tostring(av),
au,
tostring(aw)
)

aq[av]={
start=os.clock(),
type=au,
dt=aw,
}end



af.empty=function()
aq={}end




af.stop=function(au)
if not aq[au]then
return
end


aj.warn("QueuedBlocking.stop(...) - Stopping block action '%s' in queue.",tostring(au))


aq[au]=nil end



af.init=function()
local au=al.new(as.RenderStepped)
ap:mark(au:connect("QueuedInputs_Update",at))end



af.detach=function()
ap:clean()end



return af

end)
c("Game/Timings/SaveManager",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)

local af,


ag,


ah,


aj,


al,


am,


an,


ap,


aq,


ar,


as,


at,


au,


av,


aw,


az=aa("Game/Timings/TimingSave"),aa("Game/Timings/TimingContainerPair"),aa("Game/Timings/TimingContainer"),aa("Game/Timings/AnimationTiming"),aa("Game/Timings/EffectTiming"),aa("Game/Timings/PartTiming"),aa("Game/Timings/SoundTiming"),aa("Utility/Maid"),aa("Utility/Signal"),aa("Utility/Configuration"),{llc=nil,llcn=nil,lct=nil},aa("Utility/Filesystem"),aa("Utility/Logger"),aa("Utility/Deserializer"),aa("Utility/String"),aa("Utility/Serializer")


local aA,


aB,


aD,


aF=at.new("Lycoris-Rewrite-Timings"),af.new(),game:GetService("RunService"),ap.new()



as.list=function()
local aG,
aH=aA:list(true),{}

for aI=1,#aG do
local aJ=aG[aI]

if aJ:sub(-4)~=".txt"then
continue
end

local aK=aJ:find(".txt",1,true)
local aL,
aM=aJ:sub(aK,aK),aK

while aL~="/"and aL~="\\"and aL~=""do
aK=aK-1
aL=aJ:sub(aK,aK)
end

if aL=="/"or aL=="\\"then
table.insert(aH,aJ:sub(aK+1,aM-1))
end
end

return aH end




as.refresh=function(aG)
aG:SetValues(as.list())end




as.autoload=function(aG)
if not aG or#aG<=0 then
return au.longNotify("Config name cannot be empty.")
end

local aH,aI=pcall(aA.write,aA,"autoload.txt",aG)

if not aH then
au.longNotify("Failed to write autoload file %s.",aG)

return au.warn(
"Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to write autoload file %s.",
aI,
aG
)
end

au.notify("Config file %s has set to auto-load.",aG)end




as.create=function(aG)
if not aG or#aG<=0 then
return au.longNotify("Config name cannot be empty.")
end

if aA:file(aG..".txt")then
return au.longNotify("Config file %s already exists.",aG)
end

as.write(aG)end




as.save=function(aG)
if not aG or#aG<=0 then
return au.longNotify("Config name cannot be empty.")
end

if not aA:file(aG..".txt")then
return au.longNotify("Config file %s does not exist.",aG)
end

as.write(aG)end





as.write=function(aG)
if not aG or#aG<=0 then
return-1,au.longNotify("Config name cannot be empty.")
end

local aH,aI=pcall(az.marshal,aB:serialize())

if not aH then
au.longNotify("Failed to serialize config file %s.",aG)

return-2,
au.warn("Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to serialize config %s.",aI,aG)
end

aH,aI=pcall(aA.write,aA,aG..".txt",aI)

if not aH then
au.longNotify("Failed to write config file %s.",aG)

return-3,
au.warn("Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to write config %s.",aI,aG)
end

au.notify("Config file %s has written to.",aG)

return 0 end




as.clear=function(aG)
if not aG or#aG<=0 then
return au.longNotify("Config name cannot be empty.")
end

local aH,aI=pcall(az.marshal,af.new():serialize())

if not aH then
au.longNotify("Failed to serialize config file %s.",aG)

return au.warn(
"Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to serialize config %s.",
aI,
aG
)
end

aH,aI=pcall(aA.write,aA,aG..".txt",aI)

if not aH then
au.longNotify("Failed to write config file %s.",aG)

return au.warn("Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to write config %s.",aI,aG)
end

au.notify("Config file %s has been cleared.",aG)end




as.load=function(aG)
local aH=os.clock()

if not aG or#aG<=0 then
return au.longNotify("Config name cannot be empty.")
end

local aI,aJ=pcall(aA.read,aA,aG..".txt")

if not aI then
au.longNotify("Failed to read config file %s.",aG)

return au.warn("Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to read config %s.",aJ,aG)
end

aI,aJ=pcall(av.unmarshal_one,aw.tba(aJ))

if not aI then
au.longNotify("Failed to deserialize config file %s.",aG)

return au.warn(
"Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to deserialize config %s.",
aJ,
aG
)
end

if typeof(aJ)~="table"then
au.longNotify("Failed to process config file %s.",aG)

return au.warn("Timing manager failed to process config %s with result %s.",aG,tostring(aJ))
end

aB:clear()

aI,aJ=pcall(aB.load,aB,aJ)

if not aI then
au.longNotify("Failed to load config file %s.",aG)

return au.warn("Timing manager ran into the error '%s' while attempting to load config %s.",aJ,aG)
end

au.notify(
"Config file %s has loaded with %i timings in %.2f seconds.",
aG,
aB:count(),
os.clock()-aH
)

as.llc=aB:clone()
as.llcn=aG end




as.autosave=function()
if not as.llcn then
return false,-1,au.warn("No config name has been loaded for auto-save.")
end

if not as.sautos then
return false,-2,au.warn("Auto-save has been disabled.")
end

au.warn("Auto-saving timings to '%s' config file.",as.llcn)

return true,as.write(as.llcn),au.notify("Auto-save has completed successfully.")end

c("Utility/Filesystem",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)
return LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()


local af={}
af.__index=af



af.path=function(ag)
if not isfolder(ag._path)then
makefolder(ag._path)
end

return ag._path end





af.append=function(ag, ah)
return ag:path().."\\"..ah end





af.file=function(ag, ah)
return isfile(ag:append(ah))end





af.read=function(ag, ah)
if not ag:file(ah)then
return error("File does not exist or is a folder.",2)
end

return readfile(ag:append(ah))end





af.delete=function(ag, ah)
if not ag:file(ah)then
return error("File does not exist or is a folder.",2)
end

return delfile(ag:append(ah))end





af.write=function(ag, ah, aj)
writefile(ag:append(ah),aj and aj or"")end





af.list=function(ag, ah)
local aj=listfiles(ag:path())
if not aj then
return error("File list does not exist.",2)
end

local al={}

for am,an in next,aj do

al[am]=ah and an or string.sub(an,#(ag:path().."\\")+1,#an)
end

return al end





af.new=function(ag)
local ah=setmetatable({},af)
ah._path=ag
return ah end



return af
end)()

end)

c("Game/Timings/ActionContainer",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)

local af,



ag=aa("Game/Timings/Action"),{}
ag.__index=ag



ag.clone=function(ah)
local aj=ag.new()

for al,am in next,ah._data do
aj:push(am:clone())
end

return aj end





ag.equals=function(ah, aj)
if ah:count()~=aj:count()then
return false
end

for al,am in next,ah._data do
local an=aj:find(al)
if not an then
return false
end

if not am:equals(an)then
return false
end
end

return true end





ag.find=function(ah, aj)
return ah._data[aj]end




ag.remove=function(ah, aj)
ah._data[aj.name]=nil

local al=table.find(ah._stack,aj)
if not al then
return
end

table.remove(ah._stack,al)end




ag.push=function(ah, aj)
local al=aj.name


if ah._data[al]then
return error(string.format("Action name '%s' already exists in container.",al))
end

ah._data[al]=aj

table.insert(ah._stack,aj)end




ag.load=function(ah, aj)
for al,am in next,aj do
ah:push(af.new(am))
end end




ag.names=function(ah)
local aj={}

for al,am in next,ah._data do
table.insert(aj,al)
end

return aj end




ag.stack=function(ah)
return ah._stack end




ag.count=function(ah)
return#ah._stack end



ag.clear=function(ah)
ah._data={}
ah._stack={}end




ag.get=function(ah)
return ah._data end




ag.serialize=function(ah)
local aj={}

for al,am in next,ah._data do
table.insert(aj,am:serialize())
end

return aj end





ag.new=function(ah)
local aj=setmetatable({},ag)

aj._data={}
aj._stack={}

if ah then
aj:load(ah)
end

return aj end



return ag

end)

local af={}

end end

for aj,al in next,ag.timings do
ah[#ah+1]=al
end

return ah end




af.names=function(ag)

for aj,al in next,ag.timings do
ah[#ah+1]=al.name
end

table.sort(ah)

return ah end

local aj=ah:id()
if not aj then
return
end

ag.timings[aj]=nil end

return false
end

for aj,al in next,ag.timings do
local am=ah.timings[aj]
if not am then
return false
end

if not al:equals(am)then
return false
end
end

return true end

for aj,al in next,ag.timings do
ah:push(al:clone())
end

return ah end

local aj=ah:id()
if not aj then
return
end


if ag.timings[aj]then
return error(string.format("Timing identifier '%s' already exists in container.",aj))
end


if ag:find(ah.name)then
return error(string.format("Timing name '%s' already exists in container.",ah.name))
end

ag.timings[aj]=ah end



af.clear=function(ag)
ag.timings={}end




af.count=function(ag)
local ah=0

for aj in next,ag.timings do
ah=ah+1
end

return ah end




af.load=function(ag, ah)
for aj,al in next,ah do
local am=ag.module.new(al)
if not am then
continue
end

local an=am:id()
if not an then
continue
end


if ag.timings[an]then
return error(string.format("Timing identifier '%s' already exists in container.",an))
end


if ag:find(am.name)then
return error(string.format("Timing name '%s' already exists in container.",am.name))
end






ag.timings[an]=am
end end




af.serialize=function(ag)
local ah={}

for aj,al in next,ag.timings do
ah[#ah+1]=al:serialize()
end

return ah end





af.new=function(ag)

ah.timings={}

return ah end



return af

c("Utility/ReferencedMap",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)
return LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()



local af={}
af.__index=af




af.insert=function(ag, ah, aj)
local al=#ag._map+1
ag._map[al]=aj
ag._references[ah]=aj end





af.remove=function(ag, ah)
local aj=ag._references[ah]
if not aj then
return nil
end

ag._references[ah]=nil

local al=table.find(ag._map,aj)
if not al then
return nil
end

table.remove(ag._map,al)

return aj end




af.size=function(ag)
return#ag._map end




af.data=function(ag)
return ag._map end




af.new=function()
local ag=setmetatable({},af)
ag._map={}
ag._references={}
return ag end



return af
end)()

end)

end,
},
KeyPicker={
Save=function(al,am)
return{type="KeyPicker",idx=al,mode=am.Mode,key=am.Value}
end,
Load=function(al,am)
if Options[al]then
Options[al]:SetValue({am.key,am.mode})
end
end,
},

Input={
Save=function(al,am)
return{type="Input",idx=al,text=am.Value}
end,
Load=function(al,am)
if Options[al]and type(am.text)=="string"then
Options[al]:SetValue(am.text)
end
end,
},
}

aj.SetIgnoreIndexes=function(al, am)
for an,at in next,am do
al.Ignore[at]=true
end end


aj.SetFolder=function(al, am)
al.Folder=am
al:BuildFolderTree()end


aj.Save=function(al, am)
if not am then
return false,"no config file is selected"
end

local an,

at=al.Folder.."/"..am..".json",{
objects={},
keybindFramePosition=ag(al.Library.KeybindFrame.Position),
watermarkFramePosition=ag(al.Library.Watermark.Position),
infoLoggerFramePosition=ag(al.Library.InfoLoggerFrame.Position),
infoLoggerBlacklistHistory=al.Library.InfoLoggerData.KeyBlacklistHistory,
infoLoggerBlacklist=al.Library.InfoLoggerData.KeyBlacklistList,
infoLoggerCycle=al.Library.InfoLoggerData.InfoLoggerCycle,
animationVisualizerFramePosition=ag(al.Library.AnimationVisualizerFrame.Position),
overrideData=al.Library.OverrideData,
}

for au,av in next,Toggles do
if al.Ignore[au]then
continue
end

table.insert(at.objects,al.Parser[av.Type].Save(au,av))
end

for au,av in next,Options do
if not al.Parser[av.Type]then
continue
end
if al.Ignore[au]then
continue
end

table.insert(at.objects,al.Parser[av.Type].Save(au,av))
end

local au,av=pcall(af.JSONEncode,af,at)
if not au then
return false,"failed to encode data"
end

writefile(an,av)
return true end


aj.Load=function(al, am)
if not am then
return false,"no config file is selected"
end

local an=al.Folder.."/"..am..".json"
if not isfile(an)then
return false,"invalid file"
end

local at,au=pcall(af.JSONDecode,af,readfile(an))
if not at then
return false,"decode error"
end

if au.keybindFramePosition then
al.Library.KeybindFrame.Position=ah(au.keybindFramePosition)
end

if au.watermarkFramePosition then
al.Library.Watermark.Position=ah(au.watermarkFramePosition)
end

if au.infoLoggerFramePosition then
al.Library.InfoLoggerFrame.Position=ah(au.infoLoggerFramePosition)
end

if au.infoLoggerBlacklistHistory then
al.Library.InfoLoggerData.KeyBlacklistHistory=au.infoLoggerBlacklistHistory
end

if au.animationVisualizerFramePosition then
al.Library.AnimationVisualizerFrame.Position=ah(au.animationVisualizerFramePosition)
end

local av=Options["TimingOverrideList"]

if au.overrideData and av then
al.Library.OverrideData=au.overrideData

local aw={}

for az,aA in next,au.overrideData do
aw[#aw+1]=az
end

av:SetValues(aw)
end

for aw,az in next,au.objects do
if al.Parser[az.type]then
task.spawn(function()
al.Parser[az.type].Load(az.idx,az)
end)
end
end

if au.infoLoggerBlacklist then
al.Library.InfoLoggerData.KeyBlacklistList=au.infoLoggerBlacklist
al.Library:RefreshInfoLogger()
if Options and Options.BlacklistedKeys then
Options.BlacklistedKeys:SetValues(al.Library:KeyBlacklists())
end
end

if au.infoLoggerCycle then
al.Library.InfoLoggerData.InfoLoggerCycle=au.infoLoggerCycle
al.Library:RefreshInfoLogger()
if Options and Options.BlacklistedKeys then
Options.BlacklistedKeys:SetValues(al.Library:KeyBlacklists())
end
end

return true end


aj.IgnoreThemeSettings=function(al)
al:SetIgnoreIndexes({
"BackgroundColor",
"MainColor",
"AccentColor",
"OutlineColor",
"FontColor",
"ThemeManager_ThemeList",
"ThemeManager_CustomThemeList",
"ThemeManager_CustomThemeName",
})end

al.Folder,
}

makefolder(at)
end
end end


aj.RefreshConfigList=function(al)
local am,

an=listfiles(al.Folder),{}
for at=1,#am do
local au=am[at]
if au:sub(-5)==".json"then


local av=au:find(".json",1,true)
local aw,

az=av,au:sub(av,av)
while az~="/"and az~="\\"and az~=""do
av=av-1
az=au:sub(av,av)
end

if az=="/"or az=="\\"then
table.insert(an,au:sub(av+1,aw-1))
end
end
end

return an end


aj.SetLibrary=function(al, am)
al.Library=am end


aj.LoadAutoloadConfig=function(al)

end end

Options.SaveManager_ConfigList:SetValue(nil)

:AddButton("Load config",function()

local au,av=al:Load(at)

end)

return
end

if type(at)=="string"then
ah.Library[an]=Color3.fromHex(at)

if Options[an]then
Options[an]:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromHex(at))
end
else
ah.Library[an]=Color3.fromHSV(at.hue,at.sat,at.vib)

if Options[an]then
Options[an].Rainbow=at.rainbow
Options[an]:SetValue({at.hue,at.sat,at.vib},at.transparency)
Options[an]:Display()
end
end
end

ah:ThemeUpdate()end

end

ah.Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()end

Callback=function(az)

Method="GET",
Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"},
})

if not aA or not aA.Success or not aA.Body then
return af.notify("Invalid response while fetching data response.")
end

local aB,aD=pcall(aj.decode,aA.Body)
if not aB or not aD then
return af.notify("JSON error '%s' while deserializing data response.",aD)
end

af.notify("Successfully fetched Deepwoken data.")

local aF=az:gsub("https://deepwoken.co/builder%?id=",""):gsub(" ",""):gsub("\n","")
local aG=request({
Url=("https://deepwoken.co/api/proxy?url=https://api.deepwoken.co/build?id=%s"):format(aF),
Method="GET",
Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"},
})

if not aG or not aG.Success or not aG.Body then
return af.notify("Invalid response while fetching builder response.")
end

local aH,aI=pcall(aj.decode,aG.Body)
if not aH or not aI then
return af.notify("JSON error '%s' while deserializing builder response.",aI)
end

af.notify("Successfully created BuilderData object.")

ah.bdata=al.new(aI,aD)
end,
})

au:SetupDependencies({
{at,true},
})end

c("Features/Visuals/Objects/BuilderData",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)

local af,


ag,


ah,








aj=aa("Features/Visuals/Objects/DeepwokenData"),aa("Features/Visuals/Objects/AttributeData"),aa("Utility/Configuration"),{}
aj.__index=aj




aj.attributes=function(al, am)
return(al:ipre(am)==0)and al.pre or al.post end





aj.ipre=function(al, am)
local an=0

for at,au in next,am do
if typeof(at)~="string"or not at:match("Stat")then
continue
end

if typeof(au)~="number"then
continue
end

an=an+au
end

local at,
au=al.pre:points(),ah.expectOptionValue("ShrineOverrideState")

if not ah.expectToggleValue("ShrineDetectionOverride")then
au=nil
end

if au=="Pre-Shrine"then
return 0
end

if au=="Post-Shrine"then
return 1
end

if au=="Must Shrine"then
return 2
end

if not al:dshrine()then
return 1
end

if an<at then
return 0
end

if an==at then
return 2
end

return 1 end





aj.dshrine=function(al)
return not al.pre:compare(al.post)end




aj.load=function(al, am)
if typeof(am.talents)=="table"then
al.talents=am.talents
end

if typeof(am.mantras)=="table"then
al.mantras=am.mantras
end


for an,at in next,al.talents do
local au=at:gsub("%s*%[.-%]$","")

if au~=at then
al.talents[an]=au
end
end

for an,at in next,al.mantras do
local au=at:gsub("%s*%[.-%]$","")

if au~=at then
al.mantras[an]=au
end
end

if typeof(am.preShrine)=="table"then
al.pre:load(am.preShrine)
end

if typeof(am.attributes)=="table"then
al.post:load(am.attributes)
end

local an=am.stats

if typeof(an)~="table"then
return
end

local at=an.traits

if typeof(at)~="table"then
return
end

al.traits["Vitality"]=at["Vitality"]or 0
al.traits["Erudition"]=at["Erudition"]or 0
al.traits["Proficiency"]=at["Proficiency"]or 0
al.traits["Songchant"]=at["Songchant"]or 0 end






aj.new=function(al, am)
local an=setmetatable({},aj)

an.ddata=af.new(am)
an.talents={}
an.mantras={}
an.pre=ag.new()
an.post=ag.new()
an.traits={
["Vitality"]=0,
["Erudition"]=0,
["Proficiency"]=0,
["Songchant"]=0,
}

if al then
an:load(al)
end

return an end



return aj

end)
c("Features/Visuals/Objects/AttributeData",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)




local af={}
af.__index=af





af.possible=function(ag, ah)
local aj,
al=math.max(ag.base["Intelligence"],ag.base["Willpower"],ag.base["Charisma"]),math.max(ag.base["Strength"],ag.base["Fortitude"],ag.base["Agility"])

for am,an in pairs(ah)do
if ag.weapon[am]and ag.weapon[am]<an then
return false
end

if ag.attunement[am]and ag.attunement[am]<an then
return false
end

if ag.base[am]and ag.base[am]<an then
return false
end

if am=="Mind"and aj<an then
return false
end

if am=="Body"and al<an then
return false
end
end

return true end




af.points=function(ag)
local ah=0

for aj,al in pairs(ag.weapon)do
ah=ah+al
end

for aj,al in pairs(ag.attunement)do
ah=ah+al
end

for aj,al in pairs(ag.base)do
ah=ah+al
end

return ah end




af.compare=function(ag, ah)
for aj,al in pairs(ag.weapon)do
if ah.weapon[aj]==al then
continue
end

return false
end

for aj,al in pairs(ag.attunement)do
if ah.attunement[aj]==al then
continue
end

return false
end

for aj,al in pairs(ag.base)do
if ah.base[aj]==al then
continue
end

return false
end

return true end




af.load=function(ag, ah)
if typeof(ah.weapon)=="table"then
ag.weapon=ah.weapon
end

if typeof(ah.attunement)=="table"then
ag.attunement=ah.attunement
end

if typeof(ah.base)=="table"then
ag.base=ah.base
end end





af.new=function(ag)
local ah=setmetatable({},af)

ah.weapon={}
ah.attunement={}
ah.base={}

if ag then
ah:load(ag)
end

return ah end



return af

end)
c("Features/Visuals/Objects/DeepwokenData",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)



local af={}
af.__index=af



af.get=function(ag, ah)
return ag.talents[string.lower(ah)]or ag.mantras[string.lower(ah)]end






af.possible=function(ag, ah, aj)
local al=ag:get(ah)
if not al then
return false
end

local am=al.reqs
if not am then
return false
end


local an={}

for at,au in pairs(am.base)do
an[at]=au
end

for at,au in pairs(am.weapon)do
an[at]=au
end

for at,au in pairs(am.attunement)do
an[at]=au
end

return aj:possible(an)end




af.load=function(ag, ah)
if typeof(ah.talents)=="table"then
ag.talents=ah.talents
end

if typeof(ah.mantras)=="table"then
ag.mantras=ah.mantras
end end





af.new=function(ag)
local ah=setmetatable({},af)

ah.talents={}
ah.mantras={}

if ag then
ah:load(ag)
end

return ah end



return af

end)

c("Game/APBreaker",function(aa,ab,ac,ad)




local af,

ag,


ah,









aj,
al,
am,
an,
at=game:GetService("Players"),{},{"rbxassetid://9149348937","rbxassetid://10880473795","rbxassetid://5778357994","rbxassetid://16873988732","rbxassetid://7620630583","rbxassetid://8378263543",},999,50,0.05,0,Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle


ag.enabled=false
ag.currentStop=nil
ag.charConn=nil local au=function(

au)
local av=Instance.new("Animation")
av.AnimationId=au
return av end local av=function(


av)
if not av then return function()end end

local aw=av:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not aw then return function()end end

local az=aw:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if not az then
az=Instance.new("Animator")
az.Parent=aw
end

local aA={}
for aB,aD in ipairs(ah)do
local aF=az:LoadAnimation(au(aD))
aF.Priority=at
aF:AdjustWeight(am,0.001)
table.insert(aA,aF)
end

local aB,
aD=true,1/aj

task.spawn(function()
local aF=os.clock()

while aB do
if not av.Parent then break end

local aG=os.clock()
if aG>=aF then
aF=aF+aD

local aH=aA[math.random(#aA)]
pcall(function()
aH:Play(an,1,al)
aH:AdjustWeight(am,0)
end)
else
task.wait()
end
end
end)

return function()
aB=false
for aF,aG in ipairs(aA)do
pcall(function()
aG:Stop(0)
aG:Destroy()
end)
end
end end local aw=function(


aw)
if ag.currentStop then
ag.currentStop()
ag.currentStop=nil
end

if not ag.enabled then return end
if not aw then return end
ag.currentStop=av(aw)end


ag.start=function(az)
if ag.enabled then return end
ag.enabled=true

if not ag.charConn then
ag.charConn=af.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(aw)
end

local aA=af.LocalPlayer.Character
if not aA then
aA=af.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
end

aw(aA)end


ag.stop=function(az)
if not ag.enabled then return end
ag.enabled=false

if ag.currentStop then
ag.currentStop()
ag.currentStop=nil
end

if ag.charConn then
ag.charConn:Disconnect()
ag.charConn=nil
end end


return ag

end)

l=l+1
aR[n]=true
end


local m={}

for n,o in next,getnilinstances()do
if o.Name~="NulledBanRemote"then
continue
end

m[#m+1]=o
end

if#m~=2 then
if l~=2 then
return error("Anticheat has less or more than two ban remotes.")
end
end

aD=hookfunction(Instance.new("RemoteEvent").FireServer,bd)
aF=hookfunction(Instance.new("UnreliableRemoteEvent").FireServer,bc)
aJ=hookfunction(tostring,e)
aK=hookfunction(getrawmetatable(game).__index,ba)
aG=hookfunction(getrawmetatable(game).__namecall,bb)
aH=hookfunction(getrawmetatable(game).__newindex,be)
aI=hookfunction(tick,a9)
aM=hookfunction(warn,a8)
aL=hookfunction(print,a7)

local n=az:WaitForChild("EffectReplicator")
local o=aa(n)

aN=o.HasEffect

o.HasEffect=f


ah.warn("Client-side anticheat has been penetrated.")end



af.detach=function()
local g=aw.LocalPlayer

if aL then
hookfunction(print,aL)
end

if aM then
hookfunction(warn,aM)
end

if aI then
hookfunction(tick,aI)
end

if aJ then
hookfunction(tostring,aJ)
end

if aK then
hookfunction(getrawmetatable(game).__index,aK)
end

if aG then
hookfunction(getrawmetatable(game).__namecall,aG)
end

if aH then
hookfunction(getrawmetatable(game).__newindex,aH)
end

if aD then
hookfunction(Instance.new("RemoteEvent").FireServer,aD)
end

if aF then
hookfunction(Instance.new("UnreliableRemoteEvent").FireServer,aF)
end

local h=az:FindFirstChild("EffectReplicator")
local i=h and aa(h)

if aN and i then
i.HasEffect=aN
aN=nil
end

local j=g:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
local k=j and j:FindFirstChild("ClientActor")
local l=k and k:FindFirstChild("ClientManager")

if l then
l.Enabled=true
end

ah.warn("Pulled out of client-side anticheat.")end



return af

end)
return a("__root")
